title: Inversion Doubles
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n. Line 2: n integers (may be negative). Print
the number of pairs i < j with a[i] > 2*a[j].

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 200000; |a[i]| <= 1e6.

Sweep + BIT synthesis; negatives allowed.

tests.name: small mix
tests.hint: Sweep right-to-left counting earlier 2*a[j] strictly below a[i].

tests.name: negatives allowed
tests.hint: Negative values break divide-and-conquer assumptions; the BIT only needs ranks.

tests.name: load: 200000 values
tests.hint: O(n log n) sweep + BIT; the all-pairs scan is 2e10 comparisons.
